title: Counting God's Blessings Quiz
description: Let's see how well you can count and find shapes!

questions.question: How many fingers are on one hand?
questions.explanation: You have 5 fingers on one hand! God gave us fingers to count with.

questions.question: What shape is the sun?
questions.explanation: The sun is round like a circle! God made the sun to give us light (Genesis 1:16).

questions.question: What color is the grass?
questions.explanation: Grass is green! God made the beautiful green grass and plants (Genesis 1:11).

questions.question: Which animal is bigger?
questions.explanation: An elephant is the biggest! God made big animals and small animals, and each one is special.
